rows.grounds: compound of worship, place, and path

items.question: How should the worship-place path be arranged in all directions to manifest sacrifice diffusion?
premises: Division arises into five element-counted parts.
items.inference: Ritual spatial arrangement precedes consecration and manifests sacrifice.
uncertainties: Exact ritual sequence beyond given tokens.
items.plain_english: The worship path runs in all directions; to manifest the sacrifice's diffusion, one should do it; division arises into five element-counted parts; consecration is done the previous day.
